parts.latex:
\exfigure{3297_q2_1}

What is the maximum flow from source to sink through the network shown above?

solutions.latex:
The maximum flow is the sum of the flows along the paths through the network.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Maximum flow} &= 2 + 4 + 1 \\ &= 7 \end{aligned}$$
\exfigure{3297_q2_s1}

Hence the answer is option C.
